ghostMove.line.moved: Turned {count} section card ghosts into cards (kind ghost) placed in the sections
ghostMove.line.renamed: The card ghost {path} was named {name} because the name was taken (it points to {target})
ghostMove.line.rootGhost: The card ghost {path} at the root was not moved because the root cannot hold cards
ghostMove.line.standalone: Set {path} to show alone in the diagram (standalone)
ghostMove.line.targetMissing: One card ghost of section {section} was not moved because the card it points to does not exist
